text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser claims victory over 
Ikuno Dictus!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though visibly frustrated, Ikuno Dictus 
firmly looks ahead, inspired by 
Matikanetannhauser's habit of saying "Next 
time for sure!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, at Ikuno Dictus's 
recommendation, the two visited a public 
bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to recover from my fatigue 
thoroughly and get ready for the next 
race!
